name: Agent Overnight
description: Run an unattended local agent only when its adapter proves resume and unattended allow-list capabilities. The current verified provider is Claude.

projectCwd.description: Absolute path to the project directory where the agent runs. Falls back to env OPENCLAW_AGENT_BRIDGE_CWD.

provider.description: Explicit provider. Codex and Gemini fail closed until their adapters prove resume and unattended allow-list capabilities.

agentBin.description: Name or absolute path of the selected provider CLI. Strict launcher mode requires an absolute path.

allowedTools.description: Comma-separated allow-list passed to `agent --allowed-tools`. Supervisor runs without the OpenClaw perm-hook (no human in the loop overnight), so this is the only gate.

stateDir.description: Directory for per-sid state files. Falls back to <projectCwd>/.openclaw/overnight.

maxIterations.description: Safety cap on continue-loop iterations to prevent runaway.

rateLimitFallbackSleepSec.description: When rate-limit is detected but no retry-after parseable, sleep this long (5h05m by default).

iterationTimeoutMs.description: Hard cap per single `agent -p` call (kill on timeout). 1h default.
